summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, attaching a press release announcing preclinical results for Aramchol combined with enzalutamide in prostate cancer models. The study showed a 3-4 fold increase in cell death versus enzalutamide alone in VCaP cells. This is a routine clinical-stage biopharmaceutical research disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, corporate actions, or strategic events are involved. The filing merely reports scientific findings and incorporates the release into existing registration statements. Investors should monitor future clinical development and regulatory progress as regular operational updates.
